# Landing Page QA

## Content and design
- Headline matches the campaign promise.
- Offer, eligibility, price, and availability are clear.
- CTA is visible and accurately labeled.
- Text hierarchy and contrast are accessible.
- Images and videos have appropriate alternatives/captions.

## Functionality
- Forms, validation, confirmation, and error states work.
- Links and QR codes resolve correctly.
- Responsive layouts are tested.
- Page speed and tracking are checked.
- Consent and privacy notices are accurate.

## Governance
Record browser/device coverage, version, reviewer, defects, severity, and sign-off before release.
